visual_summary: In a chamber filled with armored figures and robed elders, a helmeted authority asks another leader whether he sees the significance of what is before them. A richly dressed imperial-looking figure declares it the greatest technical revolution of the century. Close-ups show a stern younger man with a forehead device and an older white-haired man reacting tensely. An elder with long white hair denounces the situation as a mistake and says their peaceful existence is ending. He then praises his son-in-law as worthy of their heritage, says they must kill their visitors, rebukes Othon for thinking like a pirate and reminds him he will become the new baron bound to imperial loyalty, then orders that the visitors be given their marble before the group prepares for coming upheavals.
